label: All of these
description: Say yes only when every input agreed: `yes` carries true when all the inputs wired onto it arrived and none of them is `false`, and nothing at all otherwise. Its inputs are the ones you wire onto it, so `rude: judge.rude` beside `sure: judge.sure` is the two-part permission a gate takes one wire for. A branch that closed never arrives, so it is a no as well, which makes this the AND of both a decision and an absence. Reads a value exactly the way a gate does: only `false` is a no, anything else is a yes.

outputs.name: yes
outputs.description: True when every wired input arrived and none was `false`. Closed otherwise, so `_should_flow` reads it as a no and `_should_not_flow` reads it as the yes.
